def check_constraint(grid):
    """Checks if every 2x2 subgrid has at least two squares of the same color."""
    N = len(grid)
    if N < 2:
        return True
    for i in range(N - 1):
        for j in range(N - 1):
            # Extract the 2x2 block
            block = [
                grid[i][j], grid[i][j+1],
                grid[i+1][j], grid[i+1][j+1]
            ]
            # Check for distinctness
            if len(set(block)) == 4:
                return False
    return True

# Test the successful 3x3 configuration found manually (K=5)

# Test a 2x2 configuration with 4 colors (should fail)
grid_2x2_4colors = [
    [1, 2],
    [3, 4]
]

# Test a valid 2x2 configuration (e.g., 3 colors)
